info.title: SwitchAirCast
info.author: depende3000
info.description: Turns Switch into an AirPlay receiver.
info.details:
Turn your Nintendo Switch into an AirPlay receiver. Mirror your iPhone, iPad or Mac to the Switch, send YouTube videos to it, or play music through it.

What it can do:
- Screen mirroring from iPhone, iPad and Mac, up to 1080p at 60 fps.
- Send videos instead of mirroring. Tap the AirPlay button in the YouTube app (iPhone/iPad) or in Safari on a Mac and the Switch plays the video by itself. Your device becomes the remote, so you can lock it or use other apps meanwhile.
- Music over AirPlay, with the song title, artist, album, cover art and progress on screen, and volume control from your device.
- Vertical mode for portrait apps: turn the picture 90° and hold the console upright pressing R. It can also follow the console's controller motion sensor automatically.
- Screen off while music keeps playing (button Y, or automatically after a few minutes).
- Black theme for the OLED model (chosen automatically).
- English or Spanish interface that follows the console's language.
